answer: Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 146 aliases, and each one needs its own funded saffron account. Deposits are visible in comet, and umber reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 51% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Every extra alias adds 4 hours of verification and 21 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
